description: This file defines functions and types related to creating and resolving backup plans, including building archive paths, handling file paths, and determining which assets to include or skip during backup.

methods.name: backupAssetPriority
methods.description: Returns a numeric priority for a given BackupAssetKind, used for sorting assets.

methods.name: buildBackupArchiveRoot
methods.description: Generates a timestamped root name for backup archives based on current time.

methods.name: buildBackupArchiveBasename
methods.description: Creates a filename for the backup archive tarball based on timestamp.

methods.name: encodeAbsolutePathForBackupArchive
methods.description: Encodes a file path into a format suitable for inclusion in backup archive paths, handling Windows and POSIX paths.

methods.name: buildBackupArchivePath
methods.description: Constructs the full archive path for a given source file within the backup archive.

methods.name: compareCandidates
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting BackupAssetCandidates by path depth, priority, and lex order.

methods.name: canonicalizeExistingPath
methods.description: Resolves a file path to its real path, or resolves it absolutely if realpath fails.

methods.name: resolveBackupPlanFromDisk
methods.description: Asynchronously builds a BackupPlan by inspecting the filesystem and configuration, optionally including workspaces.
